_comment: Maps Monarch Extractor output CSV column names to this app's internal transaction fields. Column name matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant. 'id_column' is the only strictly required entry -- upsert_transactions_by_monarch_id() cannot upsert without a stable id. Confirmed 2026-09-02 against the real Monarch Extractor/monarch_extract.py: id/date/merchant/amount/account/category/run_id are fixed columns on every row of new_transactions.csv and changed_transactions.csv; original_statement/notes/tags/owner are best-effort passthrough (present only if Monarch's own export included them).
